actual: The 2026-08-31 direct-v2 candidate passes day/minute/H5/static/index/suspend reads, but ConfigComposer emits the retired 2026-06-30 factor, qlib-bin and suspend identities. prepare_factors.py rejects the real factor meta, while qe_build_frozen_suspend_filter.py targets a nonexistent legacy-named sidecar instead of the same-release suspend_d_daily_candidate_v2 directory.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: 2026-08-31 QE/HMM v2 candidate consumer smoke passes for day/minute/H5/static/index, but ConfigComposer-generated prepare_factors.py still pins QE_DATASET_EXPECTED_META and factor-cache universe metadata to the retired 2026-06-30 dataset constants. The candidate factor meta contract is schema_version=qe_direct_factor_h5_static_v2, start=2018-08-01, end=2026-08-31, universe_key=aistock_equity_pit_canonical_v2 and has no legacy snapshot_id. A formal MA-E19R3 run would therefore fail closed or mix release identities. Add an explicit immutable direct-v2 consumer binding supplied by the selected release, validate exact factor meta and frozen day/minute/index identities without database fallback, preserve legacy/formal canonical paths, and ensure generated configuration contains no /home/lc999/data fallback. Do not modify candidate data or weaken fail-closed checks.

events.note: Added explicit five-component binding, fresh-process hash validation and direct suspend metadata support; real X-drive candidate preflight passed with zero legacy path hits.

expected: An explicit direct-v2 binding pins the same-release day, minute, factor, index, and suspend components; ConfigComposer emits only those paths and identities, and fresh-process validation fails closed on any mismatch without database or legacy-path fallback.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
